name: External Investigation Execution Confirmation 1 Code
definition: Specifies the result of an investigation, as published in an external investigation execution confirmation code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

ACDA.name: Accepted Debit Authorisation
ACDA.definition: Used when a creditor accepts the debit authorisation.

ACNR.name: Accepted Claim Non Receipt
ACNR.definition: The claim for non-receipt of a payment instruction is accepted.

ACVA.name: Accepted Value Date Adjustment
ACVA.definition: The claim for value date correction is accepted.

CHRG.name: Charges Details Provided
CHRG.definition: Further charges details are provided to resolve the case.

CNCL.name: Cancelled As Per Request
CNCL.definition: Used when a requested cancellation is successful.

CONF.name: Confirmation Of Payment
CONF.definition: Used when a payment has been checked and was correctly executed without any intervention.

CVAA.name: Correct Value Date Already Applied
CVAA.definition: The original value date was correct.

CWFW.name: Cancellation Will Follow
CWFW.definition: Used when a payment will be cancelled to solve an investigation case.

FTNA.name: Cancellation Request Forwarded To The Next Agent
FTNA.definition: The cancellation request has been forwarded to the next agent for execution.|Usage: This code should only be utilised where a Case Id is not present.

ICOV.name: Cover Initiated
ICOV.definition: Used when a transfer of funds has been initiated (a cover payment) to resolve a case.

IDUP.name: Instruction Is Duplicate
IDUP.definition: Used when the requested check for a possible duplicate instruction is confirmed.

IPAY.name: Payment Initiated
IPAY.definition: Used when the result of an investigation is, or will be, the initiation of a payment instruction.

IPYI.name: Payment Instruction Initiated
IPYI.definition: Used when a payment instruction (eg. MT103) has been initiated to resolve a case.

MCOV.name: Cover Modified
MCOV.definition: Used when a transfer of funds has been modified (a cover payment) to resolve a case.

MODI.name: Modified As Per Request
MODI.definition: Used when a requested modification is successful.

MWFW.name: Modification Will Follow
MWFW.definition: Used when the payment will be modified to solve an investigation case.

PDCR.name: Pending Cancellation Request
PDCR.definition: Used when a requested cancellation is pending.

PECR.name: Partially Executed Cancellation Request
PECR.definition: Used when a requested cancellation has been partially executed.

PURP.name: Purpose Details Provided
PURP.definition: Further purpose details are provided to resolve the case.

RJCR.name: Rejected Cancellation Request
RJCR.definition: Used when a requested cancellation has been rejected.

RJNR.name: Rejected Claim Non Receipt
RJNR.definition: The claim for non-receipt of a payment instruction is rejected.

RJVA.name: Rejected Value Date Adjustment
RJVA.definition: The claim for value date correction is rejected.

SMTC.name: Statement Entry Correct
SMTC.definition: Used when the entry in the statement is correct.

SMTI.name: Statement Entry Incorrect
SMTI.definition: Used when the entry in the statement is incorrect and further information is provided with the resolution.

UWFW.name: Unable To Apply Will Follow
UWFW.definition: Used when sender wants to respond to an assignment with an Unable To Apply workflow.

BIAS.name: Batch Instruction Already Settled
BIAS.definition: Process a cancellation request but batch already settled.

IDNE.name: Instruction Does Not Exist
IDNE.definition: Process a  Batch Cancellation "using an incorrect batch sequence number”.

IVCR.name: Invalid Cancellation Request
IVCR.definition: Process a cancellation request with incorrect reference to original batch.

INFO.name: Additional Information Sent
INFO.definition: Used when additional information has been sent to the beneficiary of a payment.

NINF.name: No Information Available
NINF.definition: Used when no additional information is available.

PDNG.name: Pending
PDNG.definition: Used to inform that a response to an investigation is pending.
